conventions.rule: Comments must not narrate what code does, label cases by letter or number, apologize, record change history, or park deferred work behind a marker
No em-dash, en-dash, double-hyphen clause break, spaced hyphen as dash, semicolon joining independent clauses, or possessive apostrophe on a pronoun or decade
Tests are named test_<behavior> with descriptive multi-word names and grouped by the module or entry script they exercise
Tests live alongside the code they cover (hooks/test_*.py, hooks/lib/test_*.py), not in a separate tests/ tree
One thin entry script per Claude Code lifecycle event under hooks/, delegating all logic to shared hooks/lib/ modules
Every rule family resolves independently to off, observe, or enforce, rather than one global on/off switch
Config resolves from .agent-discipline.json merged against schema defaults in config.py, passed down as a plain dict rather than through an injected config object
New rules launch in observe mode and graduate to enforce individually through a burn-in flow, rather than flipping the whole rule set to blocking at once
